_rules.field_tilt_with_lead: The side with the territory was chasing the game against a deep block, so territory alone overstates its control; the sentence now says how few passes reached the box.
_rules.shot_spam: Most of those shots were low-quality attempts, so the xG total says more about volume than about danger; the sentence now gives the shot count and the xG per shot.
_rules.small_sample_xg: Too few shots for an xG figure to mean much on its own; the sentence now gives the shot count.
_rules.set_piece_inflation: Most of the chances came from set pieces, so the total overstates open-play creativity; the sentence now splits the two.
_rules.wide_forward_passes: Many forward passes, but mostly wide and rarely into dangerous central areas; the sentence now gives the pass quality.
_rules.ppda_alone: PPDA alone can rank a passive side level with a pressing one in this data; the sentence now adds press intensity.
_rules.causal_claim: Event data shows what happened, not why, so a claim that one thing caused another is never published.
_rules.causal_red_card: A red card cannot be shown to have caused a result from event data, so the claim is never published.
_rules.single_match_fatigue: There is no tracking data, and one match is too small a sample to diagnose fatigue, so the claim is never published.

matchup.weak_flank.analyst: {attacker} send {attack_share}% of final-third entries down the {lane_label} (league {league_share}%), and {defender} let {concede_completion}% of entries there succeed (league {league_completion}%).
matchup.weak_flank.casual: Watch the {lane_label}: {attacker} attack it {attack_share}% of the time (most teams {league_share}%), and {concede_completion}% of attacks there work against {defender} (usually {league_completion}%).

matchup.weak_lane.analyst: {attacker} send {attack_share}% of final-third entries into the {lane_label} (league {league_share}%), and {defender} let {concede_completion}% of entries there succeed (league {league_completion}%).
matchup.weak_lane.casual: Watch the {lane_label}: {attacker} go through it {attack_share}% of the time (most teams {league_share}%), and {concede_completion}% of attacks there work against {defender} (usually {league_completion}%).

field_tilt.stat.analyst: {team} hold {amount}% field tilt in this spell.
field_tilt.stat.casual: {team} are camped in the opposition half: {amount}% of the final-third passing is theirs.

field_tilt.trailing_vs_deep_block.analyst: {team} hold {amount}% field tilt while chasing the game, but only {box_entries} of {team_f3_passes} final-third passes reached the box.
field_tilt.trailing_vs_deep_block.casual: {team} have the ball up the pitch ({amount}% of final-third passes) but just {box_entries} of {team_f3_passes} got into the box.

xg.stat.casual: {team}'s chances add up to {amount} expected goals so far.

xg.volume_vs_value.analyst: {team}: {amount} xG from {shots} shots, {xg_per_shot} xG per shot, mostly low-quality attempts.
xg.volume_vs_value.casual: {team} have taken {shots} shots, but most were long shots: {amount} expected goals in all, {xg_per_shot} per shot.

xg.small_sample.analyst: {team} have {amount} xG from only {shots} shots, too few to read much into.
xg.small_sample.casual: {team}'s {shots} shots are worth {amount} expected goals, but that is too few shots to judge.

chances_created.split.analyst: {player} ({team}) has created {amount} chances: {set_piece} from set pieces, {open_play} in open play.
chances_created.split.casual: {player} has set up {amount} chances, but {set_piece} came from set pieces and only {open_play} in open play.

forward_passes.stat.casual: {player} keeps moving {team} forward: {amount} forward passes so far.

forward_passes.wide_low_threat.analyst: {player} ({team}): {amount} forward passes, mostly wide; pass quality {pass_quality_ratio}x the league rate into central danger zones.
forward_passes.wide_low_threat.casual: {player} plays plenty of forward passes ({amount}), but mostly out wide, finding dangerous central areas at {pass_quality_ratio} times the league rate.

ppda.stat.analyst: {team} allow {amount} opponent passes per defensive action (PPDA).
ppda.stat.casual: {team} let opponents make {amount} passes before winning the ball back.

ppda.with_press_intensity.analyst: {team}: PPDA {amount}, with {press_intensity} pressure events per opponent pass.
ppda.with_press_intensity.casual: {team} press {press_intensity} times per opponent pass, letting them make {amount} passes per ball won.

momentum.shift.analyst: Momentum swings to {team}: {amount} on the tug-of-war scale, from {momentum_before} at the start of the spell.
momentum.shift.casual: {team} have taken over: the momentum meter reads {amount}, up from {momentum_before}.

rhythm.wave.analyst: Rhythm over the last {minutes} minutes: {amount} possession changes per minute.
rhythm.wave.casual: The ball has changed hands {amount} times a minute over the last {minutes} minutes.

xt_added.threat_pass.analyst: {player} ({team}) plays a pass adding {amount} expected threat.
xt_added.threat_pass.casual: Dangerous pass from {player}: it made a goal more likely by {amount} on the threat scale.

milestone.pass_count.analyst: {player} ({team}) reaches {amount} completed passes in this match.
milestone.pass_count.casual: {player} has now completed {amount} passes for {team} in this match.
